description.value:
Long before starships and blasters, warriors called upon primal spirits to guide their blows — and the Totem Specialist keeps that old tradition alive. Drawing on a faint attunement to the Force, they craft talismans imbued with the essence of legendary creatures, wearing that power into every battle.

Each totem becomes a conduit to something greater than the warrior alone: the ferocity of a predator, the resilience of a beast of legend, the clarity of a hunter's instinct. Through ritual and reverence, the Totem Specialist fights not merely as themselves, but as an echo of everything their totems represent.
